remarks: Rare opportunity to own a two-family home with rental income in New Canaan. Close to the village, train, parks, schools. Two one-bedroom apartments. First level with lovely front and back porches, eat-in kitchen, high ceilings, laundry/mudroom. Second level is lovely and bright, with vaulted, wood-clad ceilings in the eat-in kitchen and family room, very large closets and its own private porch. Full unfinished basement with mechanicals and extra storage. Both units currently have long-term tenants on month-to-month leases.
